decisions.reason: The candidate still requires permanent badges to be visible; replacing one badge and changing icon rules does not alter that visibility requirement or any existing candidate attribute.
Replacing the First Mint achievement with a First Referral badge does not change prize-ticket issuance, counters, eligibility windows, or reset behavior.
The badge-set revision does not change the reward allocation performed when a primary mint has no referral code.
Badge names and icons do not affect secondary-sale royalty destinations or the rule that secondary sales create no referral tickets.
The badge revision does not change the Big Block prize amount, winners, pool target, draw trigger, or royalty contribution.
Changing an achievement badge does not alter the manual prize-collection method.
The source decision does not change random winner selection, ticket weighting, or selection eligibility.
The badge revision does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner count, pool threshold, draw condition, or royalty contribution.
The achievement-badge change does not affect the fiat on-ramp provider, payment conversion, or supported buyer type.
References to referrals and mints are incidental; the badge revision does not alter email magic-link authentication or dashboard access.
The badge-set and icon changes do not affect the Brevo email provider or transactional email delivery behavior.
